_readme: Settings for the balloons game (the village). Change numbers here; no code change needed. catchesToWin: correct balloons needed to finish. maxDifferentLetters: how many different letters fly in one game (the target included). targetChance: 0..1, how often a new balloon carries the target letter. riseSeconds: how long a balloon takes to float from the bottom to the top (bigger = slower). Stars: a mistake is a wrong balloon, or (if countMissedAsMistake) a target balloon that floated away. 0..threeStarsMaxMistakes = 3 stars, up to twoStarsMaxMistakes = 2 stars, more = 1 star. balloonImages: painted balloons, made by tools/games/process_balloons.py; when empty the balloons are drawn in code. balloonLetterSpot: where the letter goes on those images (center x/y and size, as fractions of the image; the script prints it). background: the village picture (drawn in code when missing). backgroundMarks.feetY: where the brothers' feet go in that picture, as a fraction of its height (the middle of the dirt path).
